outcome: Composite adverse maternal outcome (postpartum hemorrhage and intensive care admission)
Composite adverse fetal outcome (stillbirth, 5-minute APGAR <7 and NICU admission)
cohort: 1324 singleton pregnancies planned for trial of labor after one previous Cesarean Section (TOLAC) over a period of 18 months
finding: Favorable Bishop Score (>4), maternal age >30 years, labor induction, and estimated fetal weight >3500 g were independently associated with successful and failed TOLAC, respectively.
